meta.title: Sekai bridge
meta.description: Bridges DSH to a Sekai world. The router plugin runs `sekai-router --serve` and publishes sekai_status, sekai_list_workers, sekai_worker_tool, and sekai_worker_task. The worker plugin runs `sekai-worker connect`, reconnects to the last router through autoConnect, relays pc.ask prompts, and publishes sekai_worker_status plus the manual connect/disconnect tools. Enable it in Plugins, then restart the session so the tools appear. Both binaries are spawned on this machine; writes and Tasks stay denied until policy.allowWrite or policy.allowTasks is enabled in the plugin settings.
